name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
description: Actively manage (inventory, track, and correct) all enterprise assets (end-user devices, servers, and network devices) on the network.

name: Data Protection
description: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data in compliance with regulatory mandates.

name: Account Management
description: Use processes and tools to assign and manage credentials for administrative accounts, user accounts, and service accounts based on least-privilege principles.

name: Security Awareness and Skills Training
description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to influence behaviors and cultivate a security-conscious culture among employees.
